description: Foundation + data: (a) tick the Task 4 parent checkbox (bookkeeping loose end -- Requirement 5 is already satisfied by the fixture-proven AliasTable::apply_locale_overlay + AliasCatalogue loader; live locale-switch wiring is Phase 3, out of scope); (b) add the ff-i18n dependency to ff-desktop and a startup catalogue bootstrap that installs the English Identity_Base catalogue via ff_i18n::set_catalogue and registers the ui.locale hot-reload callback (the first production caller of set_catalogue -- today it is installed NOWHERE); (c) author the English catalogue DATA keys for both built-in menu titles and option descriptions. This is the prerequisite for FEAT-002 and for FEAT-003's hot-reload.
steps: Tick the Task 4 parent: in docs/specs/localization/tasks.md change the line '- [ ] 4. Per-environment, per-locale alias-catalogue LOADER (no new mechanism)' to '- [x] 4. ...'. Change ONLY that one checkbox. Rationale (confirmed by reading crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/alias_overlay.rs and environment.rs): the loader mechanism + overlay logic are complete and fully unit-tested; subtasks 4.1-4.3 are already [x]; the on-disk reader and live locale-switch wiring are explicitly deferred to Phase 3 (Task 10), so Requirement 5 is met.
Add `ff-i18n = { path = "../ff-i18n" }` to crates/ff-desktop/Cargo.toml (dependencies section, near the other ff-* path deps).

Create crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/i18n_bootstrap.rs. Implement `pub(crate) fn resolve_i18n_root() -> Option<PathBuf>`: return the first existing of exe-dir `i18n`, exe-dir `..\..\i18n`, exe-dir `..\..\..\crates\ff-i18n\i18n` (dev fallback from target/<profile>), and dirs::data_dir()/FileForgeWorkbench/i18n -- mirror the help search-path pattern in construct.rs. Implement `pub(crate) fn install_catalogue(config: &ff_config::ConfigHandle)`: read ui.locale (default "en" when unset, Req 1.3), resolve the root (WARN + return early if None, leaving the seam uninstalled -- it degrades to key fallback, Req 2.4), load Catalogue::load_identity_base(root); if the locale is not en, apply load_overlay and on error WARN + keep the base (Req 1.6/2.4); call ff_i18n::set_catalogue. No unwrap/expect in non-test code.
Register the module: add `mod i18n_bootstrap;` to crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/mod.rs.

Call the bootstrap from crates/ff-desktop/src/main.rs: after step 2a (register_builtin_schema) and before the WorkbenchShell is constructed, call shell::i18n_bootstrap::install_catalogue(&config_handle). Then register ff_config::on_locale_reload(config_handle.callbacks(), move || { re-run install_catalogue against a captured ConfigHandle clone }) so a ui.locale change reloads the catalogue (Req 1.4, 1.5). Hold the returned CallbackHandle for the process lifetime.

Author the English menu keys as DATA in a new file crates/ff-i18n/i18n/en/menus.ftl (the Catalogue merges every .ftl in the dir). Keys (values = EXACT current English prose from menu_workspace/defaults.rs, ASCII, '--' for the POM title dash): menu-pom-title, menu-pom-opt-settings-desc, menu-pom-opt-catalogs-desc, menu-pom-opt-files-desc, menu-pom-opt-help-desc, menu-pom-opt-x-desc, menu-settings-title, menu-settings-opt-config-desc, menu-settings-opt-theme-desc, menu-settings-opt-menus-desc, menu-settings-opt-keys-desc, menu-settings-opt-kinds-desc, menu-settings-opt-reset-bare-desc. English base only -- NO fr/de.
acceptance_criteria: docs/specs/localization/tasks.md task 4 parent is '- [x] 4.' and no other checkbox changed (git diff shows a single-line change).
ff-desktop depends on ff-i18n and `cargo check -p ff-desktop` compiles.

A test proves install_catalogue with ui.locale=en makes ff_i18n::t("<a shipped key>") resolve to the English value (Req 3.2, 10.2); a test proves resolve_i18n_root returns None when no dir exists (Req 2.4).

crates/ff-i18n/i18n/en/menus.ftl exists, is ASCII-only, and a ff-i18n test loading the real shipped i18n/ root resolves menu-pom-title and menu-settings-opt-reset-bare-desc to their exact English prose (Req 7.1, 7.4).
verification: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-i18n *> tools\logs\feat001-i18n.log"  then read tools\logs\feat001-i18n.log and confirm all tests pass including the new menu-key test.

C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-desktop i18n_bootstrap *> tools\logs\feat001-desktop.log"  then read the log and confirm the bootstrap tests pass and ff-desktop compiles.
Use grep_search for pattern '[^\x00-\x7F]' in crates/ff-i18n/i18n/en/*.ftl (ASCII check) and confirm no non-ASCII matches.
Re-read docs/specs/localization/tasks.md and confirm line 4 is '- [x] 4.' with no other marker changed.
findings:
DONE. (a) docs/specs/localization/tasks.md: single-line change -- Task 4 parent now '- [x] 4. Per-environment, per-locale alias-catalogue LOADER (no new mechanism)'; no other checkbox touched. (b) crates/ff-desktop/Cargo.toml: added `ff-i18n = { path = "../ff-i18n" }` between ff-help and ff-session. (c) New module crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/i18n_bootstrap.rs (declared `pub(crate) mod i18n_bootstrap;` in shell/mod.rs so main.rs can reach it): resolve_i18n_root() builds the exe-dir/data-dir candidate list and delegates to first_existing_dir(); install_catalogue(&ConfigHandle) reads ui.locale via get_string (schema default 'en'), resolves the root (WARN+return if None -> seam stays uninstalled -> key fallback, Req 2.4), loads Catalogue::load_identity_base, applies load_overlay for a non-en locale (WARN+keep base on overlay/parse failure, Req 1.6/2.4), then ff_i18n::set_catalogue. No unwrap/expect in non-test code; all error paths are graceful. (d) main.rs: after step 2a (register_builtin_schema) and before the shell/eframe construction, calls shell::i18n_bootstrap::install_catalogue(&config_handle) -- the FIRST production caller of set_catalogue -- then registers ff_config::on_locale_reload(&config_handle.callbacks(), move || install_catalogue(&config_for_reload)); the returned CallbackHandle is bound to `_locale_reload_handle` held for the process lifetime (Req 1.4,1.5). (e) crates/ff-i18n/i18n/en/menus.ftl: 13 English DATA keys (menu-pom-title + 5 pom opt descs incl menu-pom-opt-x-desc; menu-settings-title + 6 settings opt descs incl menu-settings-opt-reset-bare-desc), values byte-identical to DEFAULT_POM_TOML/DEFAULT_SETTINGS_TOML with ASCII '--' dashes. ASCII-only confirmed (Select-String [^\x00-\x7F] on i18n/en/*.ftl produced no matches).

KEYS FOR FEAT-002 (render-site swap): the shipped catalogue now resolves the menu keys above. menu_workspace/render.rs has two description display sites (row Label desc + result.focused_option) and title via mod_helpers title_line_text (TabKind::MenuWorkspace -> mw.menu_title()). FEAT-002 should map a MenuOption/title to its catalogue key (likely a new menu_workspace/i18n_keys.rs) and call ff_i18n::t at those render sites; built-in menus stay code-only TOML -- localise at render time, never write translated TOML to disk. Key naming convention: menu-<menu>-title and menu-<menu>-opt-<slug>-desc.
